name: Question card
description: An audience question for Q&A: a tag, the question, and who asked it and where (e.g. via chat).

params.name: question
params.help: The question as asked. Best under 200 characters; longer text gets smaller and is cut after 4 lines

params.name: name
params.help: Who asked (empty: anonymous, no name line)

params.name: source
params.help: Where it came from, e.g. via chat, via YouTube, from the room

params.name: label
params.help: The small tag above the question

example.question: Will the new API support webhooks for every event, or only the billing ones?
example.name: Priya S.

update.question: Is there a free tier for open-source projects?
update.name: Marco D.
